The proprietary statement figures are used for business_type.

notes: GAAP city. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p7, labels p6). 'Charges for services' 57,824 split by department from the General Fund departments schedule (Ambulance 37,967 p8, Recreation 17,617 and Cemetery 2,240 p9); the General Fund is the only fund with charges. Business-type from the proprietary Total column (pp10-11): receipts = operating revenues + interest income + city sales tax; disbursements = operating expenses + interest expense (= Statement of Activities business-type expenses 4,264,643, p2); 'Gain on disposal of equipment' (44,856), a loss, recorded as business_type.other_financing. Business-type beginning net position restated (as originally reported 8,904,766 + restatement 256,445, p11). Internal service fund (governmental activities) is not in the governmental funds statements and is excluded. Governmental net position: as originally reported 6,545,634 + restatement 587,946 + change 370,518 = 7,504,098 (p3). Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (pp8-9, more detailed; the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule p14 is not recorded to avoid double counting); Street, LB840 and CDBG from their budget schedules (pp15-17, budgetary basis; zero-actual lines omitted); nonmajor funds per fund from p18 (Keno has no activity). Departmental transfers in/out include intra-General Fund transfers between departments, recorded as printed. No detail schedule for the enterprise funds. ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash and cash equivalents (p5); certificates of deposit in ending_investments; county treasurer cash 18,567 not included. Component unit (Community Development Agency) excluded. Read pages 1-20 of 20
